stage: New post-original-diel-outcome exploratory association. The four Utah taxon diel scores and six shared-cell/month contrasts are already observed; ALL six original source effects are frozen and must be replayed exactly before requesting weather.
source: Movebank public Utah UDWR four ungulates DOI 10.5441/001/1.711, original ZIP MD5 08200c9dbdf7989fb5a35467213b7e5a, no alternative source.
original_result_contract: research/MOVEBANK_UTAH_SHARED_SPATIAL_BLOCK_V0_20261019.json; maintain all four original source taxa, six pairwise source cell-month rosters, and no GPS threshold relaxation.
ecological_question: Across originally supported shared 1-degree Utah site-by-year-month cells, are environmental temperature and P-minus-reference-evapotranspiration seasonal contexts associated with differences in relative nighttime versus daytime GPS step displacement between ungulate taxa?
environment_source: ECMWF/C3S ERA5 modelled weather via Open-Meteo historical API, daily mean and maximum 2m air temperature (°C), daily precipitation (mm) and reference FAO ET0 (mm), source grid nearest with elevation=nan, fixed timezone rounded from longitude/15. Measurements are modelled coarse climate, not animal thermal exposure, observed soil moisture, forage quality or vegetation.
environment_frame: Freeze ALL 1-degree geographic cells that occur in any originally qualified two-taxon, same year-month roster; no location or calendar month selected on q sign. Retrieve complete month daily history at its fixed 1-degree cell-center coordinates (not original animal GPS). Output only counts/hashes and summaries, never cell IDs or precise tracking fixes.
weather_quality: For a cell-month require >=80% finite source daily temperature mean, temperature max, precipitation and ET0 values and at least 15 quality-admitted days. Negative precipitation/ET0 or max<mean are invalid; do not impute. Climate P-ET0 is monthly sum across qualified days, not soil water or EDW/NDVI.
estimand: First descriptive q_a−q_b on weather-qualified common site-months (fixed old roster), mean modelled mean/max temperature and monthly P-ET0; then within each distinct fixed geographic block, if >=4 matched year-months and predictor SD>=0.25°C (temperature) or >=5mm (monthly P-ET0), slope q difference against temperature mean (per °C) and water-index slope (per 100mm). Report every pair including null/undefined. Equal geographic blocks rather than treating repeated months as independent.
uncertainty: If >=5 distinct eligible geographic blocks with within-block slope for a given predictor, fixed-seed 20261019 geographic block 2000-draw bootstrap percentile interval. Otherwise NO interval. Original 6 source-level effects not reclassified. No p-values or claim of shared ecosystem replication.
inferential_ceiling: Observational exploratory environmental association, not heat or moisture causation. Monthly modelled weather is common to species at a given coarse cell-month, and taxon can differ in habitat/microclimate, sex, age, crop/forage and recruitment. No measured vegetation phenophase here: do NOT call P-ET0 NDVI or plant-resource quality.
privacy: Do not export source individual IDs, tracking coordinates, exact event dates, environment query coordinates or raw per-location ecological records. API response body hashes and aggregate source outcomes only.
